newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Dozens in hospital with typhoid in Russian region.
newsitem.headline: Dozens in hospital with typhoid in Russian region.

text.p: A total of 168 people were taken to hospital over the past two weeks with suspected typhoid in Russia's North Caucasus republic of Dagestan, an Emergencies Ministry spokeswoman said on Monday.

Typhoid has been detected at least in three districts of Dagestan with 46 confirmed cases. Health officials say leaking pipes and sewers swollen by heavy rain are the most likely cause but the outbreak was no epidemic.
The spokeswoman said 64 of those taken to hospital were children. "What we've got there is a number of cases of typhoid. But it is not epidemic," she said.
Emergencies Minister Sergei Shoigu was in Dagestan to investigate.

"The water supply system has not been repaired for many years. In addition, heavy rains have flooded the sewers in one village, sending their contents into the water supply system," the spokeswoman said.
